items.evidence: Preserved remote baseline tag and private Git bundle; 302 baseline Node tests passed.
STOCKS_PREDICTIVE_AUDIT.md traces current discovery, data, model, event, portfolio, persistence and grading paths; deployment remains unverified.

No accessible stock-provider keys or archived local research rows; production host not inspected. Real counts, timing and entitlements cannot be fabricated.

Official Alpha Vantage demo and personal-use terms checked; bounded private research downloader implemented. HF Data Library excluded for academic/non-trading restrictions. Broad live account entitlements and other providers remain unverified.

Immutable SQLite observations, versioned forecasts, JSONL cursors, same-feed full-path costed labels and label-availability purging verified locally.
Actual direction/target classifiers and return regressor, separate selection/calibration/holdout, baseline metrics, integrity-checked native artifacts; synthetic correctness fixture only.

Actual LightGBM candidates were fit/evaluated privately on documented free IBM demo history. This narrow retrospective study is not broad-market, quiet-track, execution or forward validation; no production model promoted.
Optional pinned CPU challenger and strict same-session input checks implemented; actual stock inference/benchmark not run without verified data.
Explicit abstention until verified next-session calendar, corporate actions and appropriate labels are available.

Separate quiet rank reuses verified snapshots, records flat/negative unusual activity, archives evidence and admin counts, and preserves the production shortlist. Optional bounded deep research is implemented; live runtime and predictive value remain unverified.
Early-watch observations and pre-observation movement retained; no early-prediction claim. Discord delivery and executable-entry lead-time study pending.
Future/untimestamped manual catalysts excluded from new inputs; SEC filing-date fallback, revisions, actions, verified news and surprise features need deeper point-in-time handling.
Authenticated loopback HTTP, bounded Node worker, idempotent retries and Node-to-Python integration tested. Main scanner does not await inference.
No production/cPanel access used, no hosting/runtime entitlement probe or deployment performed.

Expanding nested purged folds and untouched final holdout are implemented/tested. Five private official-demo horizon studies completed without promotion. Full Auralith replay still lacks historical champions, quote/event/context evidence.
Needs fresh authorized provider data, frozen forecasts and subsequent outcomes; no strategy promotion or profitable claim is supported.

315 Stocks Node + 17 Python tests; all 1,847 bundled Node tests and syntax checks pass. Gitleaks and known-credential publication scans found zero leaks. Raw demo data/results are ignored and not published.

Three expanding nested development folds, separate inner selection/calibration, horizon/availability embargo purging and a final 20%-date holdout; held-out outcome mutation leaves model hashes unchanged.

Five predefined intraday horizon studies executed using exact official free demo endpoints; corrected/adjusted data and assumed availability clearly marked; raw data and private results excluded from Git.
Worker requires configured authorized Alpaca credentials. No live runtime, lead-time or quiet-strategy profitability claim is supported.
